en_title: GTA 6 Doesn’t Let You Replay Story Missions — Here’s Why
cn_title: 《GTA6》不允许你重玩剧情任务——原因在此
opus_summary: 《GTA6》没有提供从菜单重玩故事任务的选项。作者认为，故事分支和此前选择可能影响任务进程，这或许是Rockstar作出这一决定的原因。游戏提供15个手动存档位，玩家可以通过存档重返特定剧情阶段。

paragraphs.en: Think you’ll want to replay some of GTA 6 ’s most exciting missions? Well, you won’t be able to simply do that from any of its menus.
paragraphs.cn: 觉得自己会想重玩《GTA6》中一些最精彩的任务吗？那么，你无法直接通过游戏中的任何菜单这么做。

paragraphs.en: Now, not every game allows you to do this, so Rockstar’s latest is by no means an outlier in this regard, but seeing as practically every one of the studio’s games since The Ballad of Gay Tony expansion for GTA 4 has allowed you to do so, it is a little surprising.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，并非每款游戏都允许你这样做，所以Rockstar的最新作品在这方面绝不算特例。但考虑到自《GTA 4》的扩展内容《The Ballad of Gay Tony》以来，这家工作室的游戏几乎都允许玩家重玩任务，这还是有点令人意外。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is a little different from other games in the series, though. Its story flows and branches in small and big ways in a fluid manner not quite seen in any of the developer’s other open worlds. I’ve only completed one full playthrough myself, but can confirm that whole missions can play out differently based on decisions you didn’t even necessarily know you were making hours earlier. For example, one of GTA 6’s best missions, a daring high-stakes heist, can go relatively smoothly or turn out to be a much messier operation.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《GTA6》与该系列的其他游戏有些不同。它的故事以这家开发商其他开放世界游戏中不曾完全见过的流畅方式推进，并在大大小小的地方产生分支。我自己只完整通关过一次，但可以确认，整个任务的进展可能会因为你数小时前作出的决定而有所不同，而你甚至未必知道自己作出了这些决定。例如，《GTA6》中最出色的任务之一是一场大胆且风险极高的劫案，它可能进行得相对顺利，也可能变成一场混乱得多的行动。

paragraphs.en: What’s most exciting is that, now knowing this, I’m left wondering how many new things I’ll see in the second playthrough I’ve just started, as much as I am looking forward to replaying the missions I can’t easily access. The decision by Rockstar not to include the option to revisit them at launch may well prove controversial, and who knows if it will be added post-launch, but I can see the argument as to why they’ve decided to do it this way.
paragraphs.cn: 最令人兴奋的是，既然知道了这一点，我不禁想知道，在刚刚开始的第二次游玩中会看到多少新东西，正如我期待重玩那些无法轻易再次体验的任务一样。Rockstar决定在游戏发售时不加入重玩任务的选项，很可能会引发争议，而谁也不知道这个选项会不会在发售后加入，但我能理解他们决定这么做的理由。

paragraphs.en: With so many moving cogs and gears working away in the background to direct Jason and Lucia’s story down certain paths, both within main missions and seemingly random events in the open world, going back to change how certain things played out may prove problematic for its flow. With no medal system implemented — another Rockstar staple that grades your performance on a scale of bronze, silver, and gold — you’d want to replay these missions purely for the fun of it rather than chase high scores or personal best times.
paragraphs.cn: 无论是在主线任务中，还是在开放世界中看似随机发生的事件里，都有如此多的齿轮在幕后运转，引导Jason和Lucia的故事走向特定的路线，因此回头改变某些事情的发展过程，可能会给故事的流畅性带来问题。由于游戏没有采用奖牌系统——Rockstar的另一项常见设计，以铜、银、金为等级评定玩家的表现——你重玩这些任务纯粹是为了乐趣，而不是追求高分或个人最佳用时。

paragraphs.en: There is one more traditional way around this problem to an extent, though, if you really do feel the urge to revisit moments: save files. GTA 6 gives you room for 15 manual save slots, and I’d highly recommend making a new one every 7% or so through the story so you’re never a million miles from reaching a point you may want to return to. With a main story that can take anywhere from 50 to 100 hours to complete depending on your playstyle, it’s always handy to have the opportunity to return to specific chapters.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，如果你真的很想重温某些时刻，还有一种更传统的方法可以在一定程度上解决这个问题：存档。《GTA6》提供了15个手动存档位，我强烈建议每推进大约7%的剧情就新建一个存档，这样你距离可能想要重返的节点就不会太远。主线剧情的完成时间可能在50到100小时之间，具体取决于你的游玩方式，因此能够回到特定章节总是很方便。

paragraphs.en: We’ve got plenty more GTA 6 for you here at IGN. You can check out our review , or head over to our launch live blog , where I’ll be doing my best to answer as many of your spoiler-free questions as you may have about the game.
paragraphs.cn: IGN还有大量《GTA6》内容供你查看。你可以阅读我们的评测，或者前往我们的发售直播博客，我会在那里尽力回答你们提出的尽可能多的关于这款游戏的非剧透问题。
